item.title: Aberfeldie — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every Melbourne suburb has a story. Aberfeldie’s story is one of farmland and orchards that became suburban housing in the post-war boom. Understanding that history explains why the suburb feels the way it does today.

See our full Aberfeldie suburb guide for the current picture.

What Aberfeldie Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Aberfeldie was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

Is Aberfeldie Expensive?

Aberfeldie sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Aberfeldie, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
